ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black) pixel regions and localized high-intensity (white) mottling patches, primarily on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive, contiguous high-intensity white mottling is mapped to the proximal and medial quadrants of the left lobe. The right lobe is characterized by a high-density low-intensity field with only sparse, low-amplitude high-intensity speckling along the posterior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.5 within its local bounding region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations detected along the entire trailing edge boundary; the distal half of the right lobe exhibits a more jagged, irregular topographic profile compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-convex trailing edge trajectory meeting at the central notch; leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve terminating in narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 6-10 circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) concentrated in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of unaligned, light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible traversing the dark pigmentation on the mid-section of the left lobe at roughly a 45-degree angle to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-intensity white pigmentation/scarring localized on the distal tip of the left lobe, which exhibits a more irregular and blunted pixel contour than the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe trailing edge contains a localized, deeper-than-average indentation (notch) approximately 75% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
